name: Pokémon FireRed & LeafGreen
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Pokemon FireRed & LeafGreen teams. Elite Four and Champion use the FIRST challenge line-ups (FRLG has higher-level rematch teams after the Sevii Islands post-game; those are not used). Champion Blue's team varies with the player's starter choice; this pack uses the variant where the PLAYER chose Bulbasaur, so Blue's starter is Charizard (Pidgeot 59, Alakazam 57, Rhydon 59, Exeggutor 59, Gyarados 61, Charizard 63). Note: Giovanni's FRLG ace is a second Rhyhorn at Lv 50, not the Rhydon from the Gen I games. Species and levels from Bulbapedia party data; abilities/items/moves intentionally blank in v1.
